description: First-load placeholder for the activity feed. One skeleton group label plus N skeleton rows shaped like ActivityRow so layout does not jump when data arrives. Reuses components/Skeleton.tsx only.

rows.description: Number of skeleton rows to render.

shownWhen: loading && events.length === 0 (first load only). Header renders normally above it.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Under AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled(), render Skeleton blocks at static mid-opacity (no pulse loop).
accessibility.announce: Optional accessibilityLabel 'Loading activity' on the container; individual skeleton blocks are decorative (accessibilityElementsHidden).
